notes.subject: to Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim Yisrael long ol sansen bilong kontrak, husat i no bihainim Tora.

notes.subject: ואכלתם/תאכלו
notes.rationale: Rotes bilong tok 'kaikai' i kamap long stat na long pinis bilong ves — klia pasin bilong Hibru, lus long Tok Pisin.

translation: Na bai yu kaikai ⟨את⟩ mit bilong ol pikinini man bilong yumi, na mit bilong ol pikinini meri bilong yumi bai yu kaikai.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol pikinini man bilong yumi
bilong ol pikinini meri bilong yumi
